title: Betrayal Game
tagline: "🏰 Explore the Astor Mansion's mysteries in 'Betrayal at the Astor Mansion'! Roll the dice, face eerie events in rooms, and uncover hidden betrayals in this immersive tabletop adventure. 🎲🕯️ #zkGaming #aleo
description: "Betrayal at the Astor Mansion" is a captivating and immersive tabletop board game that combines elements of strategy, mystery, and cooperation set against the backdrop of a historic New York mansion. This game transports players to a thrilling and suspenseful world where they step into the roles of explorers, each with unique abilities and motivations.
how_its_made: A key innovation in "Betrayal at the Astor Mansion" is the integration of Aleo, a privacy-focused zk-enabled layer-1 blockchain. Aleo's cutting-edge technology allowed for the secure storage of hidden information on the blockchain, crucial for implementing the game's hidden traitor mechanic. Player roles, hidden agendas, and secret actions are securely recorded on the blockchain, ensuring fairness and preventing cheating while maintaining player privacy.
